operations.name: uplift_project_list
operations.description: List only currently granted Uplift projects. Catalog membership does not grant access.

operations.name: uplift_project_context
operations.description: Read maintained context and revision for one granted project.

operations.name: uplift_project_upsert
operations.description: Explicitly create/update a granted project catalog entry using CAS. Requires project-management grant; never changes grants.

operations.name: uplift_source_intake
operations.description: Save an authorized artifact as an immutable Uplift receipt original. Source bytes are resolved by the trusted artifact adapter; exact source replay deduplicates.

operations.name: uplift_source_get
operations.description: Read receipt source metadata and verify immutable original hash. Returns no filesystem path.

operations.name: uplift_receipt_get
operations.description: Read receipt revision pointers, open review reasons and recent native attempt events.

operations.name: uplift_receipt_list
operations.description: List authorized receipts with an explicit cursor; original text and provisional amounts are not report acceptance.

operations.name: uplift_evidence_add
operations.description: Save an agent observation/reasoning note. It cannot label itself OCR, a user statement or a standing rule, and cannot independently ground acceptance.

operations.name: uplift_evidence_record
operations.description: INTERNAL trusted adapter only: append OCR/user/rule/project evidence with server-injected provenance. Never expose context.evidenceOrigin to model input.

operations.name: uplift_evidence_list
operations.description: List bounded excerpts and IDs of committed receipt evidence.

operations.name: uplift_evidence_read
operations.description: Read a bounded evidence excerpt and its provenance/facts. Quotes must match committed evidence exactly.

operations.name: uplift_candidate_save
operations.description: Append an immutable candidate using expected latest revision; returns current validation. Non-monetary evidence refs may carry normalized interpretations with exact quotes/rationale/ambiguity. Accept a clear valid candidate directly; a separate validate call is optional.

interpretation.description: Optional source-linked semantic normalization for vendor/date/currency/transactionRef. Exact quote and trusted source are still required. Does not ground monetary values or waive ambiguity.

operations.name: uplift_candidate_get
operations.description: Read a specific candidate revision or the latest, preserving earlier revisions.

operations.name: uplift_candidate_validate
operations.description: Recompute deterministic source/evidence/project/duplicate/monetary gates under current grants and context.

operations.name: uplift_candidate_accept
operations.description: Atomically accept the exact latest revision only after current deterministic gates; read back its financial projection. Invalid candidates remain provisional. Explicit business exceptions need a trusted user approval record and stay visibly unverified.

operations.name: uplift_duplicate_find
operations.description: Find potential alternate-scan duplicates by grounded vendor/date/currency/total. Similarity never merges or posts another expense automatically.

operations.name: uplift_receipt_exclude
operations.description: Explicitly exclude a receipt or confirmed duplicate with a reason; retains originals/history and removes only its current reporting projection.

operations.name: uplift_receipt_dispute
operations.description: Open a source-supported dispute against an accepted revision; preserve it but withhold it from final reports until resolved by a new accepted revision.

interpretation.description: Optional source-linked semantic normalization for vendor/date/currency/transactionRef. Exact quote and trusted source are still required. Does not ground monetary values or waive ambiguity.

operations.name: uplift_attempt_record
operations.description: Record a native task phase processing/processed/failure event. This is not financial acceptance or another job engine; failed optional redo leaves accepted state intact.

operations.name: uplift_review_list
operations.description: Query durable open Uplift exception views; this is not a second background queue.

operations.name: uplift_review_get
operations.description: Read a review revision, reasons, source reference and freeform responses.

operations.name: uplift_review_respond
operations.description: Append an ordinary prompt to the exact open review revision. A response alone never accepts, closes or silently rewrites the receipt.

operations.name: uplift_report_generate
operations.description: Build a private canonical JSON/CSV/PDF/XLSX expense report. Final rows include only current accepted revisions; draft provisional rows remain separate, unsupported itemization and disputes are withheld, and currencies never combine.

operations.name: uplift_operation_get
operations.description: Read the actor-owned committed financial operation receipt before retrying an uncertain mutation; current grants are rechecked.
